# Weightloss Tracker

> Free web app for steady weight loss, made for people who want to track progress rather than food: log your weight and see weekly and all-time charts, BMI, an estimated body fat percentage and estimated fat loss, your goal with an estimated date, milestones, body measurements and smart-scale readings you record yourself, with optional weekly reminder and monthly report emails. No food or calorie logging. Built by someone on GLP-1 medication who has lost over 20 kg. Sign in with an email code, Google or Microsoft. English, German, Spanish and French.

The app's figures are estimates worked out from what you enter; it does not connect to scales or other devices.

## Pages

- [Home](https://weightloss-tracker.com/): what it does, who it is for (including people on GLP-1 medication), screenshots, questions, sign up or sign in
- [Features](https://weightloss-tracker.com/features): every feature with screenshots, and published sources on weight loss and health
- [How it works](https://weightloss-tracker.com/how-it-works): getting started step by step
- [About](https://weightloss-tracker.com/about): why the app was built and how it grew, feature by feature
- [Questions and answers](https://weightloss-tracker.com/faq): cost, sign-in, units, languages, GLP-1, emails, body fat estimate, smart scales, your data
- [BMI calculator](https://weightloss-tracker.com/bmi-calculator): free, runs in the browser, metric or imperial
- [Privacy and cookies](https://weightloss-tracker.com/privacy): what is stored, cookies, outside services and your rights
- [Terms of use](https://weightloss-tracker.com/terms): the rules for using the service; not medical advice; governed by the law of England and Wales
